feedback_text: The app keeps crashing whenever I try to make a payment. This is unacceptable!
I love the new dashboard design. So much easier to navigate. Great work!
Please add dark mode. I use the app at night and it is way too bright.
Customer support took 5 days to respond and still did not solve my problem.
The loading time is extremely slow. Reports take forever to generate.
Would love a mobile app for iOS and Android. Desktop only is limiting.
Login keeps failing with 2FA. I have been locked out for 3 days.
Overall great product. Very happy with the analytics features.
Can you please add CSV export? I need to share data with my team.
The billing page is confusing and I was charged twice this month. Need refund.
Really impressed with the sentiment analysis accuracy.
I wish there was an offline mode. My internet is unreliable.
App crashed 3 times today. Lost all my unsaved work. Serious bug!
Team collaboration features are excellent. We work together seamlessly.
Please integrate with Slack for alerts when new feedback comes in.
Password reset emails are not arriving. Cannot access my account.
Topic modeling feature is brilliant. Identified our pain points automatically.
Would love multi-language support. Customers write in Spanish and French.
Subscription cancellation is too complicated. Took 30 minutes to cancel.
The AI chat is incredibly useful. Answers questions about data instantly.
Performance has degraded significantly in the last week. Everything is slow.
Please add SSO support. We use Google Workspace and need single sign-on.
Report generation saved hours of manual work. PDF output looks professional.
Error 500 when uploading large CSV files. System should handle bigger files.
Amazing product. Feature request detection helps us prioritize our roadmap.
